event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: CRO 221179 was represented by Edi Jurman.
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area B).
Antonio Poretti (coach of CRO 221179), and Max Jablecki (race committee member) attended the hearing as observers.
Before the hearing, CRO 221179 went to the race committee and asked to review the video of the start of race 11 (F5).
facts: In race 11 (F5) of the ILCA 4 Boys gold fleet, the black flag was used as the preparatory signal.
Within the last 10 seconds before the starting signal of the race, CRO 221179 was inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark, close to the pin end.
CRO 221179 was identified by the race committee on the pin end vessel of the starting line.
The race committee displayed a general recall after the starting signal of the race.
The race committee displayed CRO 221179's sail number on the board before the next warning signal.
CRO 221179 was scored BFD in race 11 (F5).
conclusions: By scoring CRO 221179 who was identified inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal as BFD, the race committee did not do an improper action or omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to CRO 221179.
